text: 美国银行策略师Michael Hartnett表示，随着投资者寻求规避利率上升以及美国中期选举和人工智能主题交易带来的波动，预计未来数周风险厌恶情绪将主导市场。Hartnett在一份报告中表示，今年夏季的“极度看涨情绪”已经结束。全球债券普遍遭到抛售，推动经通胀调整后的实际收益率升至3%，能源价格上涨和通胀黏性也加剧了投资者的担忧。“鉴于实际收益率达到3%，未来3至4周我们继续倾向于规避风险，”Hartnett表示。其团队预计，鉴于通胀连续逾五年高于央行目标，美联储将在10月加息以“恢复信誉”。Hartnett还认为，民主党在11月中期选举中实现‘浪潮式
text_en: Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett said that as investors seek to avoid rising interest rates and the volatility brought by U.S. midterm elections and AI-themed trades, risk-averse sentiment is expected to dominate markets in the coming weeks. Hartnett said in a report that the "extremely bullish sentiment" of this summer has ended. Global bonds have been broadly sold off, pushing inflation-adjusted real yields to 3%, while rising energy prices and sticky inflation have also intensified investor concerns. "Given real yields at 3%, we continue to favor risk aversion over the next 3 to 4 weeks," Hartnett said. His team expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates in October to "restore credibility," given that inflation has exceeded central bank targets for more than five consecutive years. Hartnett also believes Democrats will achieve a 'wave'
